title: Member Equities & Patronage — Servicing Rule and Booking Reference for Reinvested Class H Preferred Stock Dividends
content:
A Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding whose dividend option is reinvest receives each declared quarter's dividend as additional preferred shares.

## Rule

1. A Class H Preferred Stock holding whose dividend option is reinvest receives each declared quarter's dividend as additional preferred shares, booked as one reinvested dividend entry effective on the declared payment date of that quarter (the 15th day after the quarter end).
2. The quarterly preferred dividend is fixed only after the holding carries a cancellation entry for every share it held above the largest balance a member may hold.
3. A holding whose dividend option is cash is paid the dividend in cash and is outside this rule; a holding already carrying a reinvested dividend entry for the declared payment date has nothing further booked.

## Business effect

The servicing desk books the dividend on the member's preferred stock holding as one reinvested dividend entry for the dividend amount, effective on the declared payment date, and the holding's balance rises by the same amount — one share of 1.00 par for each dollar reinvested. The member then sees the reinvested dividend in the holding's activity and the higher balance.

## Platform reference: `book_preferred_dividend_reinvestment_5d71129c`

**Capability.** Books one quarter's Class H Preferred Stock dividend as reinvested in additional preferred shares: a reinvested dividend entry for the amount given, effective on the dividend payment date given, raising the holding's balance by the same amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the servicing representative unlocks `book_preferred_dividend_reinvestment_5d71129c` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `equity_id` | The reference number of the member's Class H Preferred Stock holding, read from the member's equity holdings lookup | Identifier, text |
| `amount` | The dividend reinvested | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |
| `payment_date` | The dividend payment date of the quarter being booked | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time part |

**Return.** On success a receipt with `status` "booked"; `eq_txn_id`, the reference of the new reinvested dividend entry (text); `equity_id`, the holding booked to (text); `amount`, the USD reinvested (2 decimal places); `effective_date`, the dividend payment date (YYYY-MM-DD); and `new_balance`, the holding's balance after the reinvestment (USD, 2 decimal places). The call has succeeded when this receipt is returned.

## Contract questions

**Which date does the entry carry?** The dividend payment date passed in `payment_date`, which becomes the entry's effective date.

**How many shares does the entry add?** One share of 1.00 par for each dollar of `amount`.
